purpose: Teach: 見せつけ/混じり/ふやす/腰掛け/役立た/焼か/溶かし/襲い

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様への愛情を見せつけるみたいにお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I noticed how he was showing his affection for you and his child so openly today.
lines.style: Gentle observation, warm undertone. Soft delivery, unhurried pace. The tone of someone noticing something good and wanting to acknowledge it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、笑顔混じりにご注文されたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, and he ordered with such a bright smile on his face.
lines.style: Pleased but measured. A slight lift in the voice on the smile part. Grounded, not gushing — the warmth of quiet approval.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、リピーターをふやす施策を考えようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, we should think about ways to keep customers like him coming back, don't you think?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, forward-focused. Conversational tone, collaborative — inviting her into the thinking, not directing from above.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、窓際に腰掛けるのがお気に入りだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I think he's mentioned before how much he loves sitting by the window.
lines.style: Soft recognition. The gentle way of reminding someone of a pattern they might already sense. Unhurried, observant.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、無駄な備品は役立たないから処分しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, we should clear out some of the things that aren't really being used — they're just taking up space.
lines.style: Practical suggestion delivered gently. Clear-headed but not harsh. The tone of someone who notices what matters and what doesn't.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店でパンを焼かれる時間を増やしてみようか、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, maybe we could try baking more fresh bread in the shop — it might bring people in.
lines.style: Thoughtful idea, collaborative energy. Open question at the heart of it, not a directive. Warm and exploratory in tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ホットチョコレートはチョコを溶かして作るのよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, hot chocolate really does need the chocolate melted down just right, doesn't it?
lines.style: Tender teaching moment. Knowing tone — sharing a small truth about something she cares about. Unhurried, intimate.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、台風が襲い来る予報だから準備しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, there's a typhoon coming in the forecast — we should prepare the shop before it hits.
lines.style: Calm urgency. Clear-headed, practical shift in energy. Not alarmed, just matter-of-fact and protective about what matters.
